title: Are We Overthinking One-Step Generation?
abstract: Diffusion and flow matching are now dominant frameworks for generative modeling in continuous domains, but they typically require multiple network evaluations at inference. This has motivated extensive research on one-step generative modeling primarily built on diffusion and flow, though existing approaches often rely on complex training machinery. In this work, we introduce Priming Models, a simple two-stage framework for training one-step generators. Motivated by the difficulty of distributional training from scratch, Priming Models are first trained on a reconstruction objective, e.g., pixel-space denoising at a fixed noise level, before undergoing feature-space distributional post-training. Our central scientific finding is that this simple reconstruction stage is already enough to entirely alleviate the difficulty of distributional training. Empirically, across class-conditional image generation, text-to-image generation, and world modeling, Priming Models significantly advance the Pareto frontier of training compute vs. generation quality. On ImageNet at $256 \times 256$ resolution, we achieve a state-of-the-art FID of $1.19$ among one-step generators using approximately one-tenth the training compute of prior methods with comparable FID. We open-source our codebase at https://github.com/JaeyeonKim01/priming.

analysis.sourceNote: 依据exact version 2610.20331v1 (45 pages). 全文文本与关键图表核验。数字均为作者报告，本项目未独立复现。 Code: available.
analysis.ideaZh: Priming Models 先学简单reconstruction（ImageNet甚至固定s=0.8），再把同一网络作为noise-to-image generator做feature-space OT distribution matching。作者报告one-step ImageNet FID1.19、238.95EFLOPs；简化的是训练路线，仍依赖预训练perceptual/features，T2I最佳版还用logit-normal，world-model仅8帧分段重锚评估。
analysis.motivationZh: 直接distributional one-step训练难从random weights开始，现有少步方法常需teacher、特殊trajectory或style-conditioning；问题是能否用简单reconstruction提供更易优化的初始化。
analysis.methodZh: Stage1重建corrupted clean samples，可固定noise0.8并加perceptual loss；Stage2同网络从Gaussian一次出图，在冻结feature branches中匹配generated/real分布，并减去独立stop-gradient generated reference的self interaction；OT coupling stop-gradient、反向经feature encoder到generator。
methodFlow: Gaussian noise一次生成active及独立reference样本
analysis.experimentsZh: ImageNet1K256²：115.1M B/405.1M L、80/160epochs fixed-noise pretrain+25k OT，8H200；T2I MiniT2I258M pixel512²+frozen FLAN-T5，CC12M+120k mixture；world RT-1/BridgeV2 latent U-Net，64epochs+4k OT。所有数值为作者报告。 作者报告结果：作者报告L160 FID1.19、238.95EFLOPs；Drifting-L1.61、1476.39；B80为1.47、85.75。 (Table 1, p. 6) 作者报告T2I最佳one-step0.818/82.16、420.16EFLOPs；固定s0.8版0.740/81.30、293.53；MeanFlow1step0.548/76.49、546.64。 (Table 2, p. 8) 作者报告RT-1 FVD30.96，仍不及32step flow27.24；BridgeV2 FVD32.58 vs39.87。 (Table 3, p. 8) 作者报告去perceptual FID1.38→2.07，OT替为energy/Laplacian为1.95/1.85。 (Table 4, p. 9) 对照范围：主要比pixel MeanFlow、Drifting、latent W-Flow/iMF及multistep JiT，统一torch-fidelity重算FID；排除了直接优化FID的FD-loss0.72主表配置，故不能宣称无条件one-step SOTA。主FDr5 encoders未用于主ImageNet训练，但部分替代feature消融直接重叠评价feature。compute含两阶段与feature forward/backward，不代表从零获取所有feature encoders的完整成本。 消融与诊断：fixed noise sweep、无perceptual、masking/RAE初始化、OT/MMD/energy、feature branches、FD-loss均检查；Jacobian alignment为4checkpoints×8classes的关联，ConvNeXt global-mean不遵循同排序。替代pretraining部分posttrain12.5k而主参考25k，不能直接归因所有差异。
analysis.insightZh: 不是新OT或新架构，而是显示很简单的reconstruction initialization即可让直接distribution matching显著更易训练，减少对diffusion/flow trajectory与teacher的依赖。理论说明stop-gradient surrogate与divergence梯度的关系；Jacobian解释为关联性实证，不能视作充分因果证明。
analysis.evidenceZh: 固定noise reconstruction后，同网络直接从纯Gaussian生成，并优化feature distributional surrogate。 (Sec. 2.1, Eqs. 1–3, pp. 3–4; Appendix B, pp. 17–20); 作者报告Priming-L160 one-step FID1.19/FDr5 7.10、238.95EFLOPs。 (Table 1, p. 6; Sec. 3.1, pp. 6–7); 作者报告T2I固定noise0.740/81.30，logit-normal0.818/82.16（GenEval/DPG）。 (Table 2, p. 8); world evaluation每8帧重锚真实context，并与SD3-VAE重建而非原始pixel比较。 (Sec. 3.3, p. 8; Appendix C.3, pp. 22–23); 去perceptual loss FID1.38→2.07；noise1.0预训练退化为65.08。 (Table 4 and Sec. 4.1, p. 9)
analysis.whyRelevantZh: Image Generation重大训练路线候选：以简单reconstruction初始化直接distribution matching，方法清晰、受控消融较完整，可研究少步视觉生成的训练难点；未验证3D或structured design。
analysis.caveatZh: 依赖预训练feature encoders，能否去除仍待研究。; reconstruction与Jacobian alignment关系需要更深入解释。; 对multistep diffusion/flow仍有性能差距。; 固定noise足够不代表最佳T2I仍用固定noise；最佳值来自更长logit-normal预训练。; world模型每8帧真实重锚、FVD仅前16预测帧且target为VAE重建，不是长时自由rollout验证。; 三seeds是sampling evaluation，并非独立training重复；Jacobian关联不能解释全部训练改善。; 主表排除直接优化FID的更低FID方法，不能用1.19声称覆盖所有one-step配置。; 公开代码目前覆盖ImageNet256，T2I/world实现不应宣称已开放。
